newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France cargo traffic and load factor rise in March.
newsitem.headline: Air France cargo traffic and load factor rise in March.

text.p: Air France recorded a 3.4 percent increase in cargo traffic in March 1997, with 452.5 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK), figures from the French national carrier show.
The overall cargo load factor in March 1997 was up 2.2 percentange points on the same month the previous year at 75.3 percent, the airline said.
In the 12 months of its financial year - which ran from April 1 1996 to March 31 1997 - Air France transported 4.86 billion FTK, up 5.7 percent on April 1995-March 1996.
The cargo load factor in 1996/97 at 69.4 percent was up 0.8 percentage points on 1995/96, the airline added.
FTK is the multiple of the weight of cargo carried and the distance flown. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
